transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because my family thinks I'm doing too much. I don't see it that way, though. We're moving, and I'm just making sure it gets done right. Building the new garage, getting things sorted at the church... plus I'm still working, showing the younger guys at the plant how the mixers actually operate. It just feels like I'm the only one with the drive to actually get it all handled.
Have you been needing less sleep than usual lately?
I don't know. I haven't really kept track of it. I guess I sleep about the same as I always do... I get enough to keep going, anyway.
Have you been feeling especially confident or unusually sure of your abilities lately?
No... I wouldn't call it that. I just know what needs doing. I've been at the plant a long time, so I know how things work. That's all.
Have you felt unusually upbeat or energized lately?

I wouldn't say upbeat. I just... I feel good. But it's frustrating when people drag their feet. They either need to get on board with my plans or just get out of my way. 

I guess I've been a little short with them. One minute we're joking around and I feel ten feet tall, and the next... I don't know, I end up snapping at my wife or my boy over some little question. It's just aggravating when they can't keep up.
Does this level of taking on projects and pushing to get things done feel noticeably more intense than your usual self?

I don't know about intense. I'm just... I'm getting things done. Everyone keeps telling me I'm doing too much, which is why I'm sitting here. But honestly, it just feels like I'm the only one with the drive to actually handle things. 

We're moving, and I've got to get that sorted. Plus, I need to rebuild the garage at the new place so it's done right. And there's organizing things over at the church... and I still have to show the younger guys at the plant how the job is actually supposed to be done. It's just what needs doing. I wouldn't call it intense.
Have you had any thoughts that you have special powers, a unique mission, or abilities beyond what other people have?
No. I'm just a guy who knows how to work. That's it. I don't know anything about... special powers or whatever. I just have my experience.
Has there been a clear period recently when you were acting noticeably different from your usual self?
I don't... no. Not really. I'm the same as I've always been. Like I said, I'm just getting things done. I don't know what you mean by different.
Have you been more active or taking on more projects than you usually do?

I suppose. I just... I can't seem to sit in a chair for more than a few minutes right now. I end up getting up to... sort boxes, or go measure the garage. Loading up tools, driving back over to the old place. 

I don't know. My body just feels like it's got a motor in it. I just have to keep moving.
Have you been talking more than usual lately?

I guess. My family says I do. Once I get going about... what needs doing around the house or the garage, I suppose the words just keep coming. They tell me I talk over them. Too fast. Say they can't even get a word in to tell me to stop. I don't know, I just... have a lot to say right now, I guess.
Have you been taking on more projects than you usually do?

I suppose. That's... well, everyone keeps saying I'm doing too much. But to me, it just feels like I'm the only one with enough drive to actually get it all handled. 

The move, I mean. And rebuilding the new garage so it's done right. Plus organizing things down at the church... and I still have to show the younger fellows at the shop how the job actually ought to be done. I don't know. It's not taking on more, it's just doing what needs doing.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Depressed? No... I don't think so. I mean, I've always just gone to work. Never really had the time to sit around and... feel like that, I guess. So, no.
Before this recent stretch, have you ever had another time in your life when you were like this?
No, I don't... I don't think so. I've always just been a hard worker. This is... well, this is just me getting things done. I don't know about any other times.
Has this led to you being hospitalized, or has it caused such serious problems that you couldn't manage your work or home responsibilities?

No hospitals. But... well, I guess there were some issues. They actually pulled me off the floor at the shop... said there was a safety incident. I don't know. 

And at home... my wife and the kids kind of stopped trusting me with things. The money, the driving... even decisions about the move. They said things were getting out of hand. But like I said, I was just trying to get it all done.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I thought you already asked me that... but no. Like I said before, I haven't really had time for that kind of thing. Just... always working. So, no.
Has there ever been a time in your life when you lost interest in almost everything you usually enjoy?
No. I just... I like to work. I don't really have hobbies to lose interest in.
At any time in your life, have you had a period when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks?
No. I just... I don't get down like that. I just keep busy.
How long has this period of feeling driven and constantly on the go been going on?
About a month, I guess. Started when... well, when we had to start clearing out of the old house. Just haven't stopped since.
During this past month, has this gotten bad enough that you could not manage your usual responsibilities at work or home?

Well... yeah, I guess. They, uh... they sent me home from the plant. Had a bit of a safety thing. And, uh... my wife, she... well, she won't let me drive right now. Or handle the money for the move. Says things got too out of hand.
